endpoint: Final 301 samples inside 0.1 rad, no drop. Also score ever entered before drop and drop.
design: Use nominal training resets for direct comparison with the three existing matched X specialists. Compare on new paired perturbed starts. Only change the fixed goal quaternion for Y/Z. Reuse each X seed's archived epoch-5512 dwell checkpoint. Freeze the endpoint for every seed. Use the same new banks for a frozen X-on-each-axis transfer control. Never select on confirmation banks.
gate: Train a unified policy if BOTH Y and Z have at least two of three independent seeds holding the final 5 seconds on at least 50% of development cases each. Freeze this rule before training. Report all seeds and confirm finalists on separate banks even if gate fails.
joint_if_eligible: Uniform per-episode XYZ targets. Train three seeds. Compare after 5512 epochs (equal total budget) and at 16536 epochs (~matched per-axis exposure); report per-axis exposure, X retention and equal bank scores.
visual_sample: For each specialist axis choose the median development-score seed. On first confirmation bank select first slot of each observed outcome: held, reached but failed, never reached. Review rigid-body motion for these cases.
